title: Build a Fully Autonomous Instagram AI Agent
one_liner: How to set up an AI agent that scrapes, rewrites, and posts Instagram carousels automatically.
key_points: More Instagram accounts than you'd expect are fully autonomous AI agents running without human input
Stack four skills: scrape viral posts, rewrite as carousel scripts, generate carousel visuals, then auto-post on a schedule
The agent runs asynchronously — set it up once and let it loop indefinitely
Biggest creative limitation: the AI works best by remixing what already went viral, not generating original ideas
